name: Black Bird
description: As Jimmy Keene begins a 10-year prison sentence, he gets an incredible offer: If he can elicit a confession from suspected killer Larry Hall, Jimmy will be freed. Completing this mission becomes the challenge of a lifetime.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Jimmy Keene is living in the fast lane—until he gets a 10-year prison sentence. Behind bars, he's approached about a high-stakes deal for freedom.

videos.title: We Are Coming, Father Abraham
videos.overview: Agent McCauley prepares Jimmy for the mission. Detective Miller questions Larry about the missing women, leading to a polygraph test.

videos.title: Hand to Mouth
videos.overview: Struggling with his transition to maximum security prison, Jimmy initiates a friendship with Larry. New holes in Larry's stories are uncovered.

videos.title: WhatsHerName
videos.overview: In the aftermath of a prison riot, Jimmy and Larry find themselves with time to learn more about each other.

videos.title: The Place I Lie
videos.overview: Jimmy's mounting fear and paranoia compel him to provoke Larry. McCauley and Miller have a breakthrough. Larry's therapist grows concerned.

videos.title: You Promised
videos.overview: Jimmy reaches his breaking point. Larry becomes suspicious. McCauley and Miller talk to an important person in Larry's life.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 9 wins & 23 nominations total
